rationale: Replace the queued pending-transaction treatment with the completed ownership sequence proven by regulatory filings. Ardian held 41.9% from July 2019 and reached 100% in April 2025. Blackstone announced the acquisition on September 15, 2025, FERC authorized it on March 19, 2026, and the direct consummation notice establishes a March 26, 2026 close. Blackstone is current and Ardian is former; no later exit or pending transfer was identified.

identityResolution.managerLevelBoundary: Count the single 620 MW Hill Top plant company. Exclude seller/buyer holding entities, affiliated acquisition vehicles, service providers and counterparties as separate PortCos.
identityResolution.duplicateDecision: Correct the existing production company in place; do not create a second company or pending buyer record.

currentOwner.stake: 100% indirect ownership through affiliated Blackstone funds; aggregator interests include 76.28% ETP IV and 14.72% BXE IV

acquisitionExitCheck.ownershipEntry: Ardian acquired 41.9% in July 2019 and the balance in April 2025; Blackstone's definitive agreement was announced September 15, 2025.

acquisitionExitCheck.currentOwnership: A June 2026 regulatory filing continues to identify Hill Top as an indirect wholly owned Blackstone subsidiary.
acquisitionExitCheck.subsequentExitSearch: No later sale, signed pending exit or ownership transfer was identified through 2026-08-15.
